title: Appeal 32104 (reconsideration, plumbing): bored 4-inch HDPE storm line under a building slab instead of an open trench (701.2 approved materials)
jurisdiction: City of Portland, Oregon (USA), Bureau of Development Services Administrative Appeal Board; non-Alberta comparative record

facts.text: Appeal item: section 701.2 requires approved materials under the structure; the request is for SDR 17 / ASTM F714 4-inch HDPE storm pipe bored about 40 feet to 70 feet under the building slab.

Reason: boring avoids an open-cut trench through about 30 linear feet of slab; the request also says the existing storm line is improperly located parallel to the curb and that the building sits on the property line.

Reconsideration: the request says the 1,360 square-foot addition's roof run-off is adequately served by 4-inch pipe, that the original catch basin was removed, and the driveway will be replaced with pervious pavers.

Attached hand-drawn sketch (file 41415) shows a proposed 4-inch HDPE storm line, an existing 4-inch concrete storm line marked for abandonment, an existing 6-inch lateral, and the existing building sewer line.
